# Optional slash commands

One shortcut for people who want a menu. The short ask is the same job and stays the paved path.

| Command | Ask it replaces |
|---------|-----------------|
| `sync` | *Update the doc templates from Agentic Doc Templates and sync our live docs.* |

Installed only when `optional_rules.slash-commands` is `enabled`. Each `tools/<key>.md` says where the file goes. A tool with no command folder still records the choice; the short ask is the path there.

Do not add more commands here. Do not paste the sync playbook into this file. Delete a leftover `orchestrate` command from an older pack.
